name: Power Saving
author: Kike Ferrater
description: Four idle stages, each with its own switch and timeout: screensaver and monitor standby for the display, lock and suspend for the system. Adds the monitor standby and idle suspend that Omarchy does not have.

barWidget.description: Status icon with a panel that shows the idle stages in firing order, switches each on or off and sets its minutes. Right-click toggles stay-awake.
